newsitem.title: USA: US junk bond funds get $183 mln in new cash-AMG.
newsitem.headline: US junk bond funds get $183 mln in new cash-AMG.

text.p: Net cash inflows into high-yield bond mutual funds were $183 million for the latest recorded week which ended on July 2, according to AMG Data Services.
Inflows totalled $75.9 million and $391 million in the preceding two weeks, respectively.
The data is tallied from high-yield bond funds that report on a weekly basis. They exclude reinvested distributions.
AMG, based in Arcata, Calif., is a U.S. mutual fund information company.
